116: 116: (vi) Cross-Default. A Cross-Default occurs with respect to such party, as defined and supplemented by Annex II, Section 10.
117: 117: Paragraph 10(b) — Consequences of an Event of Default
118: 118: 10.2 Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default with respect to a Defaulting Party, the Non-Defaulting Party may, at any time thereafter, by written notice to the Defaulting Party (or, in the case of an Act of Insolvency, without the requirement for any notice if the Act of Insolvency constitutes an ipso facto trigger as set out in Annex II, Section 11(b)), designate an "Early Termination Date" in respect of all (but not less than all) outstanding Transactions.
119: 119: 10.3 Upon designation of an Early Termination Date, no further payments or deliveries shall be required to be made by either party in respect of any Transaction, other than the net amount (if any) determined in accordance with the close-out and netting provisions of this Paragraph 10.
120: 120: 10.4 The standard close-out netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. The Default Market Value of each Transaction shall be determined in accordance with Paragraph 10(d) of the 2011 ICMA GMRA, and the amounts so determined shall be aggregated and netted in accordance with the provisions thereof to produce a single net amount payable by one party to the other. The party owing such net amount shall pay it to the other party on the Early Termination Date (or, if such date is not a Business Day, on the next following Business Day) in the Base Currency.
121: 121: 10.5 The rights and remedies of the Non-Defaulting Party under this Paragraph 10 are in addition to, and without prejudice to, any other rights or remedies available to it under this Agreement, at law, or in equity.
122: 122: Paragraph 11 — Tax
123: 123: Paragraph 11(a) — General Tax Provisions
124: 124: 11.1 The standard tax provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations arising in connection with this Agreement and any Transaction, and each party shall provide to the other party such tax forms, certificates, and other documentation as the other party may reasonably request in order to establish any available exemption from, or reduction in the rate of, any withholding or deduction for or on account of tax.
125: 125: 11.2 Each party represents that it has provided, or will provide promptly upon request, accurate and complete information regarding its tax status, residency, and any applicable tax identification numbers to the other party, and will promptly notify the other party of any change in such information.
126: 126: Paragraph 11(b) — Tax Gross-Up
127: 127: 11.3 Elected. If either party (the "Tax Payor") is required by any applicable law, regulation, or governmental or regulatory authority to make any deduction or withholding from any payment due under this Agreement (including, without limitation, any Manufactured Payment, any payment of the Purchase Price or the Repurchase Price, any payment of Cash Margin, or any payment of a close-out amount), the Tax Payor shall pay such additional amounts (the "Tax Gross-Up Amounts") as may be necessary to ensure that the other party (the "Tax Payee") receives the full amount that it would have received had no such deduction or withholding been required.
128: 128: 11.4 The Tax Payor's obligation to pay Tax Gross-Up Amounts shall not apply to the extent that the deduction or withholding arises as a result of (a) the Tax Payee's failure to provide any tax form, certificate, or other documentation reasonably requested by the Tax Payor, (b) the Tax Payee's failure to comply with any applicable procedural requirement for claiming an exemption from or reduction in the rate of withholding, or (c) a change in tax residency of the Tax Payee after the date of this Agreement.
129: 129: 11.5 Cure Period. If a Tax Payor fails to pay any Tax Gross-Up Amount required under this Paragraph 11(b), the Tax Payee shall give written notice of such failure to the Tax Payor. The Tax Payor shall have a cure period of five (5) Business Days from receipt of such notice within which to pay the outstanding Tax Gross-Up Amount in full. Failure of the Tax Payor to cure such failure within such five (5) Business Day period shall constitute an Event of Default with respect to the Tax Payor, and the Tax Payee may thereafter exercise its rights under Paragraph 10(b) of this Agreement.
130: 130: Paragraph 12 — Interest
131: 131: 12.1 The standard interest provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. If any amount payable by a party under this Agreement is not paid on the date on which it falls due, interest shall accrue on such unpaid amount from (and including) the due date to (but excluding) the date of actual payment, at a rate per annum equal to the overnight rate for the relevant currency (as determined by the Non-Defaulting Party in a commercially reasonable manner, by reference to the rate published by the relevant central bank or an equivalent interbank overnight rate source) plus one percent (1%) per annum.
132: 132: 12.2 Interest accruing under this Paragraph 12 shall be calculated on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed and a 360-day year (in the case of USD and EUR) or a 365-day year (in the case of GBP), and shall be payable on demand.
133: 133: 12.3 The payment of interest under this Paragraph 12 shall be without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to the Non-Defaulting Party under this Agreement or at law.
134: 134: Paragraph 13 — Single Agreement
135: 135: 13.1 This Agreement, Annex I, Annex II, and all Confirmations exchanged between the parties shall together constitute a single agreement between the parties. Each party acknowledges that it has entered into this Agreement, and will enter into each Transaction hereunder, in reliance on the fact that all such documents form a single agreement between the parties.
136: 136: 13.2 In the event of any inconsistency between the body of this Agreement and the terms of Annex I, Annex II, or any Confirmation, the order of priority set out in Paragraph 1.3 shall apply.
137: 137: Paragraph 14 — Notices
138: 138: 14.1 All notices, requests, demands, and other communications required or permitted to be given under this Agreement shall be in writing (which, for this purpose, includes electronic mail) and shall be delivered to the addresses and to the attention of the persons specified in Annex II, Section 14.
139: 139: 14.2 Any such notice shall be deemed to be effective upon actual receipt by the addressee (or its authorised representative) at the address specified in Annex II, Section 14, or at such other address as the relevant party may have notified to the other party in writing in accordance with this Paragraph 14.
140: 140: 14.3 Either party may change its address, contact person, or electronic mail address for the purposes of this Paragraph 14 by giving not less than five (5) Business Days' prior written notice to the other party.
141: 141: Paragraph 15 — Entire Agreement; Severability
142: 142: 15.1 Entire Agreement. This Agreement (including Annex I, Annex II, and all Confirmations) constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous negotiations, representations, warranties, commitments, offers, discussions, and agreements (whether written or oral) between the parties relating to such subject matter.
143: 143: 15.2 Severability. If any provision of this Agreement (or any part thereof) is found by any court, tribunal, or arbitral body of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, unlawful, or unenforceable in any respect, such invalidity, unlawfulness, or unenforceability shall not affect the remaining provisions (or the remaining part of such provision) of this Agreement, which shall continue in full force and effect. The parties shall negotiate in good faith to replace any invalid, unlawful, or unenforceable provision with a valid and enforceable provision that, to the greatest extent possible, achieves the economic, commercial, and legal objectives of the invalid, unlawful, or unenforceable provision.
144: 144: Paragraph 16 — Non-assignability; Termination
145: 145: 16.1 Non-assignability. Neither party may assign, transfer, charge, or otherwise dispose of any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party. Any purported assignment, transfer, charge, or disposal made in contravention of this Paragraph 16.1 shall be null and void and of no effect.
146: 146: 16.2 Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement (but not any outstanding Transaction) by giving not less than thirty (30) calendar days' prior written notice to the other party. Upon the effective date of such termination, no further Transactions may be entered into under this Agreement, but all Transactions outstanding at the effective date of termination shall continue to be governed by and subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement until all obligations of the parties in respect of such Transactions have been fully performed and discharged.
147: 147: Paragraph 17 — Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
148: 148: Paragraph 17(a) — Governing Law
149: 149: 17.1 This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it (including, without limitation, any question regarding its existence, validity, interpretation, performance, breach, or termination, and any claim based in tort, unjust enrichment, or any other legal or equitable principle) shall be governed by and construed in accordance with English law.
150: 150: 17.2 The choice of English law as the governing law of this Agreement shall not be affected by any change in the domicile, residence, registered office, or place of business of either party.
151: 151: Paragraph 17(b) — Dispute Resolution
152: 152: 17.3 Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of, relating to, or in connection with this Agreement, including any question regarding its existence, validity, interpretation, breach, or termination (a "Dispute"), shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the Rules of the London Court of International Arbitration ("LCIA") as in force at the time of filing of the request for arbitration (the "LCIA Rules"), which rules are deemed to be incorporated by reference into this Paragraph 17(b).
153: 153: 17.4 The seat, or legal place, of the arbitration shall be London, England. The designation of London as the seat of arbitration shall not preclude the holding of hearings, meetings, or deliberations at other locations if agreed by the parties or determined by the arbitral tribunal.
154: 154: 17.5 The number of arbitrators shall be three (3), unless the parties agree otherwise in writing after the Dispute has arisen. In the absence of any such agreement, (a) the claimant(s) shall nominate one arbitrator, (b) the respondent(s) shall nominate one arbitrator, and (c) the two arbitrators so nominated shall, within thirty (30) days of the nomination of the second arbitrator, agree upon and nominate a third arbitrator who shall serve as the presiding arbitrator. If the two party-nominated arbitrators fail to agree upon a presiding arbitrator within such thirty (30) day period, the LCIA Court shall appoint the presiding arbitrator in accordance with the LCIA Rules.
155: 155: 17.6 The language of the arbitration, including all written submissions, oral hearings, and the arbitral award, shall be English.
156: 156: 17.7 The arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties, and judgment on the award may be entered and enforced in any court of competent jurisdiction, including (without limitation) any court of the State of New York, any court of the United States of America, and the courts of England and Wales. Each party irrevocably waives any right to challenge, resist, or oppose enforcement of such arbitral award in any jurisdiction.
157: 157: 17.8 Nothing in this Paragraph 17(b) shall prevent either party from seeking interim or conservatory measures from any court of competent jurisdiction, including injunctive relief, attachment, or other provisional remedies, and any such application shall not be deemed a waiver of, or inconsistent with, the agreement to arbitrate contained herein.
158: 158: Paragraph 18 — No Waivers, etc.
159: 159: 18.1 No failure or delay by either party in exercising any right, power, or remedy under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right, power, or remedy preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, power, or remedy.
160: 160: 18.2 No waiver of any provision of this Agreement or consent to any departure therefrom shall be effective unless given in writing and signed by the waiving party, and then such waiver or consent shall be effective only in the specific instance and for the specific purpose for which given.
161: 161: 18.3 The rights and remedies provided in this Agreement are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights or remedies provided by law.
162: 162: Paragraph 19 — Waiver of Immunity
163: 163: 19.1 Each party irrevocably waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, with respect to itself and its revenues, assets, and properties (irrespective of their use or intended use), all immunity on the grounds of sovereignty or other similar grounds from (a) suit or proceeding, (b) jurisdiction of any court or tribunal, (c) relief by way of injunction or order for specific performance or recovery of property, (d) attachment of its assets (whether before or after judgment), and (e) execution or enforcement of any judgment, arbitral award, or order to which it or its revenues, assets, or properties might otherwise be entitled in any proceedings in the courts or tribunals of any jurisdiction.
164: 164: 19.2 Each party consents generally to the giving of any relief or the issue of any process in connection with any proceedings relating to this Agreement and any Transaction, and acknowledges that no immunity from such proceedings shall be claimed by or on behalf of itself or with respect to its assets.
165: 165: Paragraph 20 — Recording
166: 166: 20.1 Each party consents to the recording of telephone conversations and electronic communications (including, without limitation, electronic mail, instant messaging, and Bloomberg messaging) between the parties and between any persons acting on behalf of the parties in connection with this Agreement and any Transaction.
167: 167: 20.2 Each party acknowledges that such recordings may be used as evidence in any proceedings relating to this Agreement or any Transaction. Each party agrees to inform its relevant personnel that their communications may be recorded and to take such steps as may be necessary under applicable law to ensure that such recording is lawful.
168: 169: ANNEX I — SUPPLEMENTAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (2011 Version)
169: 170: The full text of the Supplemental Terms and Conditions for the 2011 ICMA Global Master Repurchase Agreement, as published by the International Capital Market Association, is hereby incorporated by reference and forms part of this Agreement, without amendment except as expressly modified by Annex II (Elections, Supplements, and Amendments).
170: 171: The 2011 Annex I sets out the standard supplemental terms governing, among other matters:
171: 172: (a) additional margin maintenance provisions, including the calculation of Transaction Exposure, the valuation methodology for determining Market Value, and the treatment of accrued but unpaid Income;

173: 174: (c) mini close-out provisions, including the right of the Non-Defaulting Party to close out individual Transactions following the occurrence and continuance of an Event of Default, without prejudice to its right to designate an Early Termination Date in respect of all outstanding Transactions;
174: 175: (d) provisions relating to the treatment of margin transfers, the application of Cash Margin, and the right to apply equivalent margin in the form of Additional Purchased Securities;
175: 176: (e) provisions relating to the acceleration and termination of Transactions upon the occurrence of specified events; and
176: 177: (f) such other supplemental terms and conditions as form part of the standard 2011 ICMA GMRA framework.
177: 178: The parties acknowledge and agree that the provisions of the 2011 Annex I are an integral part of this Agreement and shall be read and construed together with the body of this Agreement and Annex II. In the event of any inconsistency between the provisions of the 2011 Annex I and the provisions of Annex II, the provisions of Annex II shall prevail.

199: 201: The Base Currency for all purposes under this Agreement shall be United States Dollars (USD). All calculations required to be made under this Agreement in a single currency (including calculations of Transaction Exposure, Margin Deficit, Margin Excess, Net Exposure, Delivery Amount, Return Amount, and Default Market Value) shall be made in, or converted into, the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange prevailing at the relevant time of determination, as reasonably determined by Buyer.

201: 203: (a) "Eligible Sovereign Securities" means fixed-rate or floating-rate debt securities denominated in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, or CHF and issued by the central government (or a central government-guaranteed agency) of any of the following G7 nations: the United States of America, the United Kingdom, Germany (Bundesrepublik Deutschland), France (République française), Japan, Canada, and Italy (Repubblica Italiana), provided that:

013: Paragraph 1 — Applicability

014: 1.1 This Agreement is a Global Master Repurchase Agreement in the form published by the International Capital Market Association in 2011 (the "2011 ICMA GMRA"), as supplemented by Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions) in the form published by ICMA in 2011 (the "2011 Annex I") and by Annex II (Elections, Supplements, and Amendments) attached hereto and forming part hereof.

015: 1.2 This Agreement, together with Annex I, Annex II, each Confirmation exchanged between the parties, and any other schedules, appendices, or annexes expressly incorporated herein by reference, shall together constitute a single agreement between Buyer and Seller (collectively, the "Agreement"). Each of the parties acknowledges that all Transactions entered into on or after the date of this Agreement are entered into in reliance on the fact that this Agreement, Annex I, Annex II, and all Confirmations form a single agreement between the parties.

016: 1.3 Each Transaction entered into between the parties on or after the date of this Agreement shall be governed by and subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. In the event of any inconsistency between the provisions of the body of this Agreement and the provisions of Annex I or Annex II, the provisions of Annex II shall prevail, followed by the provisions of Annex I, and then by the provisions of the body of this Agreement.

017: 1.4 Buy/Sell Back Transactions: Not Applicable. The parties do not intend to enter into Buy/Sell Back Transactions under this Agreement. If the parties wish to enter into Buy/Sell Back Transactions, they shall negotiate and agree a separate annex or amendment to this Agreement addressing such Transactions.

018: 1.5 Agency Transactions: Not Applicable. Neither party acts as agent for any third party in connection with any Transaction entered into under this Agreement. If the parties wish to enter into Agency Transactions, they shall negotiate and agree a separate annex or amendment to this Agreement addressing such Transactions.
019: Paragraph 2 — Definitions

020: 2.1 Unless otherwise defined in this Agreement or the context otherwise requires, capitalised terms used in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, which definitions are hereby incorporated by reference as if set out in full herein.

021: 2.2 In addition to the definitions set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and the 2011 Annex I, the following additional defined terms are introduced in Annex II and, to the extent set out therein, shall apply for the purposes of this Agreement:
022: (a) "Eligible Collateral" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(c).
023: (b) "Eligible Sovereign Securities" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(a).
024: (c) "Eligible Corporate Securities" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 3(b).
025: (d) "Haircut" or "Haircut Percentage" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 4.
026: (e) "Margin Threshold" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 5.
027: (f) "Net Exposure Cap" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 6.
028: (g) "Repricing Date" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 12.
029: (h) "Cross-Default Threshold" has the meaning given in Annex II, Section 10(c).
030: (i) "Act of Insolvency Grace Period" means zero (0) days, as specified in Annex II, Section 11(b).

031: 2.3 In the event of any inconsistency between a definition contained in Annex II and a definition of the same term contained in the body of this Agreement, the 2011 ICMA GMRA, or the 2011 Annex I, the definition in Annex II shall prevail.

032: 2.4 "Base Currency" means United States Dollars (USD). All calculations of Transaction Exposure, Margin Deficit, Margin Excess, Net Exposure, and all other amounts required to be computed in a single currency under this Agreement shall be calculated in, or converted into, the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange prevailing at the relevant time of determination, as reasonably determined by Buyer.

033: 2.5 "Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday or Sunday) on which commercial banks are open for general business (including dealings in foreign exchange and foreign currency deposits) in both London, England and New York, New York, United States of America.
034: 2.6 For the avoidance of doubt, where any term is defined in both this Paragraph 2 and in Annex II, the Annex II definition shall govern.
035: Paragraph 3 — Initiation; Confirmations

036: 3.1 Each Transaction shall be entered into by telephone, electronic messaging (including Bloomberg messaging, SWIFT, or electronic mail), or such other method as may be agreed between the parties from time to time. Each party shall designate one or more authorised persons who shall have authority to enter into Transactions on its behalf, and each party shall provide the other with a written list of such authorised persons, updated from time to time as necessary.

037: 3.2 Each Transaction shall be evidenced by a Confirmation in writing delivered by Buyer or Seller (as agreed between the parties for such purpose) by close of business on the Business Day following the Purchase Date. A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail, facsimile, or through an electronic trade confirmation platform used by both parties. Each party shall use reasonable efforts to respond promptly to any Confirmation received and to notify the other party of any discrepancy in the terms set out therein.
038: 3.3 The Confirmation for each Transaction shall specify, at a minimum, the following:
039: (a) the Purchase Date;
040: (b) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is an open Transaction or an "on demand" Transaction, a statement to that effect;

041: (c) the Purchased Securities, including the International Securities Identification Number (ISIN), the nominal amount or face value, and a description (including issuer name, coupon rate, and maturity date) of such securities;
042: (d) the Purchase Price;
043: (e) the Repurchase Price or, alternatively, the Pricing Rate and the basis for computation of the Repurchase Price;
044: (f) Buyer's account details for the receipt of Purchased Securities and for the payment of the Purchase Price;
045: (g) Seller's account details for the delivery of Purchased Securities and for the receipt of the Purchase Price;
046: (h) the applicable Haircut Percentage;

047: (i) any additional terms specifically agreed between the parties for that Transaction, including any special conditions, additional collateral requirements, or modifications to the standard terms of this Agreement applicable solely to that Transaction.

048: 3.4 A Confirmation shall, upon delivery, supplement, form part of, and be subject to this Agreement. Together with this Agreement, each Confirmation shall evidence a complete and binding agreement between the parties with respect to the Transaction to which it relates. In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of a Confirmation and the terms of this Agreement (including Annex I and Annex II), the terms of the Confirmation shall prevail with respect to the Transaction to which such Confirmation relates, unless the Confirmation expressly provides otherwise.

049: 3.5 The failure by either party to deliver a Confirmation with respect to a Transaction shall not affect the validity or enforceability of that Transaction, provided that the terms thereof have been agreed between the parties.
050: Paragraph 4 — Margin Maintenance
051: Paragraph 4(a) — Margin Deficit / Margin Excess

052: 4.1 The parties shall, on each Business Day (or at such other intervals as may be agreed), mark to market all outstanding Transactions by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities and the Transaction Exposure in respect of each Transaction, each calculated in the Base Currency.

053: 4.2 If at any time the aggregate Cash Margin (if any) held by or on behalf of Buyer, together with the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), is less than the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a "Margin Deficit" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Deficit shall be equal to the shortfall, calculated in the Base Currency.

054: 4.3 If at any time the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), together with any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer, exceeds the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a "Margin Excess" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Excess shall be equal to the surplus, calculated in the Base Currency.
055: Paragraph 4(b) — Delivery Amount / Return Amount

056: 4.4 Upon the existence of a Margin Deficit, Buyer may by notice to Seller (a "Margin Call") require Seller to transfer to Buyer Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) in an amount sufficient to eliminate such Margin Deficit (the aggregate amount so required, the "Delivery Amount"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Delivery Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(a) (being $250,000 as of the date hereof).

057: 4.5 Upon the existence of a Margin Excess, Seller may by notice to Buyer (also a "Margin Call") require Buyer to transfer to Seller Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) sufficient to eliminate such Margin Excess (the aggregate amount so required, the "Return Amount"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Return Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(b) (being $250,000 as of the date hereof).

058: 4.6 Any Additional Purchased Securities transferred by Seller to Buyer pursuant to a Margin Call must constitute Eligible Collateral, and the Market Value of such Additional Purchased Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) shall be at least equal to the Delivery Amount.
059: Paragraph 4(c) — Margin Call Timing

060: 4.7 A Margin Call must be received by the other party by the margin call cut-off time specified in Annex II, Section 7 (being 10:00 a.m. London time as of the date hereof) in order for the resulting transfer to be required on that same Business Day.
061: 4.8 If a Margin Call is received before the cut-off time on a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on that same Business Day.

062: 4.9 If a Margin Call is received at or after the cut-off time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on the next following Business Day.

259: (d) For the purposes of determining whether the Cross-Default Threshold has been exceeded, all amounts of Specified Indebtedness in respect of which the relevant event has occurred shall be aggregated (regardless of whether such amounts arise under the same or different agreements or instruments).
260: Section 11 — Act of Insolvency
261: (a) The definition of "Act of Insolvency" shall be as set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA, supplemented as follows.

262: (b) Grace Period: None (zero days). An Act of Insolvency shall constitute an Event of Default immediately and automatically upon occurrence, without requirement for notice or lapse of any period of time (an "ipso facto trigger"). For the avoidance of doubt, upon the occurrence of an Act of Insolvency with respect to a party, the other party shall be entitled, without the requirement for any notice to the Defaulting Party, to designate an Early Termination Date in respect of all outstanding Transactions in accordance with Paragraph 10(b).

263: (c) For the avoidance of doubt, and without limiting the definition of Act of Insolvency set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA, each of the following shall constitute an Act of Insolvency for the purposes of this Agreement:

268: (v) the taking of any corporate or other action by a party in furtherance of any of the foregoing; or

272: (b) Buyer shall exercise a Repricing Event by delivering written notice to Seller not less than two (2) Business Days prior to the applicable Repricing Date. Such notice shall specify the Transaction to be repriced and the proposed Repricing Date.
273: (c) Upon the occurrence of a Repricing Event:

274: (i) the original Transaction shall terminate on the Repricing Date as if such date were the Repurchase Date, and Seller shall pay to Buyer the Repurchase Price applicable to the original Transaction as of the Repricing Date;
275: (ii) simultaneously, the parties shall enter into a new Transaction on terms identical to the original Transaction, save that:

277: (B) the Purchase Price of the new Transaction shall be recalculated based on the Market Value of the Purchased Securities on the Repricing Date (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage); and

278: (C) the Pricing Rate shall be as agreed by the parties or, failing agreement by 5:00 p.m. London time on the Business Day immediately preceding the Repricing Date, the Pricing Rate applicable to the original Transaction shall continue to apply to the new Transaction;

279: (iii) the close-out amount, if any, arising from the termination of the original Transaction and the simultaneous commencement of the new Transaction shall be calculated as the difference between the Repurchase Price of the original Transaction and the Purchase Price of the new Transaction.
